Sub FixNum
d=ThisComponent
For i=0 To d.DrawPages.Count-1
p=d.DrawPages.getByIndex(i)
For j=0 To p.Count-1
s=p.getByIndex(j)
t=Trim(s.String)
If Len(t)>0 And Len(t)<4 And IsNumeric(t) Then s.CharColor=RGB(255,0,0)
Next j
Next i
End Sub
then F5, alt+f4, ctrl+s, Enter(Keep format)
